Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing intersection, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: left, right; parking: on-street
- commercial building at center, 3 stories, brick, flat roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, street lamp, trash can, bench
- landscape: grass strip
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2015
Smartphone era fully arrived. A 2015 main street mid-revival — the video store replaced by a phone repair shop, third-wave coffee and a vape shop, smartphones in every hand.

CONDITION: abandoned — closed business, boarded windows, weeds through pavement cracks, weathered surfaces

PERIOD DETAILS
- BLUE PLATE DINER with 'COFFEE $2.25' chalked on a menu board
- barber shop with its spinning barber pole, now billed as a 'classic barbershop'
- craft beer taproom with a hand-drawn chalkboard sidewalk sign
- window signs: 'SCREEN REPAIR FROM $49', 'HAPPY HOUR 4-6 — PINTS $4'
- a dog water bowl outside a cafe door
- chalkboard sandwich-board signs outside the cafes
Typography: minimalist flat sans-serif, simplified modern logos.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
NO people anywhere — the place is completely deserted.

VEHICLES
NO vehicles anywhere — empty lot, no parked or moving cars.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: power and phone lines routed underground along the main commercial block, no utility poles along the street frontage; conduits below grade

DECAY
- weeds through pavement cracks, the curb
- trash along storefronts, a dumped mattress at the curb
- graffiti on boarded panels, lower wall
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- deciduous tree at left: established tree, modest canopy
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — DSLR or smartphone camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: clean, minimal noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
